description: Narrow and elongated. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: L-shaped or U-shaped, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. Two cooks can work simultaneously on separate counter runs. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: Sofa at upper-left area facing inward toward the room; double bed in upper-right corner near windows; dining table with four chairs positioned mid-right. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall unclear. Cook may see TV from cooking position. Diners unclear if facing the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is blank wall, L-shaped corridor, medium length. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Studio apartment. Double bed. Bed not visible from front door, partially visible from kitchen. Fully open plan — cooking smells and sounds reach the sleeping area directly. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. One bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet). Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples comfortable with combined living and sleeping space. Not suitable for: families with children (studio with no separate bedrooms); roommates needing privacy (fully open sleeping area); anyone needing a dedicated home office (no desk, open plan); people requiring separation between sleeping and living zones.
